title: CppCon 2014: Jeff Preshing "How Ubisoft Develops Games for Multicore - Before and After C++11"
summary: CppCon 2014 talk by Jeff Preshing on how Ubisoft Montreal developed games for multicore hardware, before and after C++11 concurrency support. It goes into atomics and lock-free programming in practice.
why: Recommended as a clear, practical introduction to atomics and lock-free programming in C++.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Jeff Preshing gave a really good introduction to atomics at CppCon 2014.[1]
